mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) may increase neurotoxicity risk in patients receiving levetiracetam, particularly concerning ototoxicity and CNS effects; both drugs have renal elimination and amikacin nephrotoxicity may affect levetiracetam clearance.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, assess for hearing changes and neurological symptoms; consider alternative antibiotics if possible, especially in patients with baseline renal impairment.
